info.name: KwalityCareMobile API - Customer & Vendor
info.description: Mobile app API collection for customer and vendor apps. Set base_url e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1. Legacy requests are unchanged. New APIs (OTP login, guest-cart, portal /me, sub-services, mobile banners, coupon validate, extra items, KYC documents) were appended Aug 2026. Responses in samples keep status + error_code wrapping; live Laravel payloads remain the original resource JSON unless noted.

request.description: Check if client app build and version are valid or require force update. Valid app_type values: customer, vendor. Works with both GET and POST.

response.name: 200 OK (App is Up to Date - can_proceed: true)
response.body:
{
  "status": true,
  "force_update": false,
  "can_proceed": true,
  "message": "App is up to date.",
  "data": {
    "app_type": "customer",
    "comparison": "same",
    "can_proceed": true,
    "force_update": false,
    "client_version": "1.0.0",
    "client_build_number": 1,
    "current_version": "1.0.0",
    "current_build_number": 1
  }
}

response.name: 200 OK (Force Update Required - status: false, force_update: true)
response.body:
{
  "status": false,
  "force_update": true,
  "can_proceed": false,
  "message": "Update required. Please update your app to continue.",
  "data": {
    "app_type": "customer",
    "comparison": "lower",
    "can_proceed": false,
    "force_update": true,
    "client_version": "0.9.0",
    "client_build_number": 1,
    "current_version": "1.0.0",
    "current_build_number": 1
  }
}

item.name: New Mobile APIs (do not replace legacy)
item.description: Pointers only. Canonical copies live in the folders above. Old URLs stay valid.

request.description: New: customers/login/send-otp + verify-otp, customers/guest-cart/*, customers/me/*, sub-services, mobile-banners, coupons/validate, extra-items approve/reject, kyc-documents, partners/check-availability, customers/check-availability. Create booking still accepts old keys; tip_amount and items[].quantity are optional extras. frontend-content now also returns mobile_banners.
